newsitem.title: TAIWAN: CPC No.3 cracker reopens after repair.
newsitem.headline: CPC No.3 cracker reopens after repair.

text.p: Taiwan's state monopoly Chinese Petroleum Corp plans to reopen its No.3 naphtha cracking plant on Saturday after 20-day minor repairs, company officials said on Friday.
"The No.3 cracker will resume operation on Saturday," a company official said. "We fixed a compressor on the cracker."
CPC's fifth cracker has an annual production capacity of 400,000 tonnes of ethylene.
CPC's third cracker has an annual production capacity of 230,000 tonnes of ethylene and its fourth cracker has annual capacity of 385,000 tonnes.
It has shut down its first and second crackers.
